# The iOS sample app (iOS step i.1b): the shared C++ core, Hermes, the Objective-C++ host and the Swift renderer in one
# Xcode project, generated by CMake's Xcode generator (the core already builds with CMake). How the runtime will be
# packaged for app authors (Swift package, XCFramework) is decided later (docs/milestones.md, i.2).
#
# Needs: bun run tools/fetch-hermes-apple.ts, bun run sample:js. Then:
#   cmake -G Xcode -S ios -B ios/build/sim -DCMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME=iOS -DCMAKE_OSX_SYSROOT=iphonesimulator
#   xcodebuild -project ios/build/sim/zn_ios.xcodeproj -target ZnSample -sdk iphonesimulator -configuration Debug build
# One build folder per SDK: CMake picks the hermesvm.xcframework slice when it configures (spike shortcut).
# Building by -target, not -scheme: Xcode 26 lists no destinations while the iOS 26.2 device platform isn't installed.
# tools/ios-sample.ts does all of it, installs on the booted simulator and launches the app.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.28)
project(zn_ios LANGUAGES C CXX OBJC OBJCXX Swift)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_OBJCXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_OSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET 17.0)  # @Observable (open: see milestones.md, minimum iOS version)
set(CMAKE_Swift_LANGUAGE_VERSION 5.0)  # spike shortcut: Swift 6 strict concurrency later

set(ZN_REPO "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/..")
set(ZN_HERMES_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party/hermes/debug/destroot" CACHE PATH "Hermes destroot")
set(hermes_xcf "${ZN_HERMES_DIR}/Library/Frameworks/universal/hermesvm.xcframework")
if(NOT EXISTS "${hermes_xcf}/Info.plist")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "No Hermes at ${hermes_xcf}. Run: bun run tools/fetch-hermes-apple.ts")
endif()

# The targets core/CMakeLists.txt expects from its host. JSI is built into hermesvm on Apple platforms.
add_library(hermes-engine::hermesvm SHARED IMPORTED)
set_target_properties(hermes-engine::hermesvm PROPERTIES
  IMPORTED_LOCATION "${hermes_xcf}"
  INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${ZN_HERMES_DIR}/include"
)
add_library(zn_jsi INTERFACE)
# MMKV links zlib through find_library, which returns one SDK's absolute path (the device one by default). Plain `z`
# lets each SDK's linker find its own.
set(zlib "z" CACHE STRING "zlib for MMKV" FORCE)
add_subdirectory("${ZN_REPO}/core" zn_core)

set(bundle_dir "${ZN_REPO}/android/sample/src/main/assets")
set(bundle_files "${bundle_dir}/main.hbc" "${bundle_dir}/main.zn.ui" "${bundle_dir}/main.zn.ui.json"
  "${bundle_dir}/zn-bundle.json")  # what the built-in bundle is: OTA bundles are checked against it (ZnOta.swift)
foreach(f IN LISTS bundle_files)
  if(NOT EXISTS "${f}")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "No ${f}. Run: bun run sample:js")
  endif()
endforeach()

# The bundle's assets (images for `asset:` sources, Lottie files, app fonts), kept in their folders inside the app.
file(GLOB_RECURSE asset_files CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${bundle_dir}/images/*" "${bundle_dir}/lottie/*" "${bundle_dir}/fonts/*")
foreach(f IN LISTS asset_files)
  file(RELATIVE_PATH rel "${bundle_dir}" "${f}")
  get_filename_component(dir "${rel}" DIRECTORY)
  set_source_files_properties("${f}" PROPERTIES MACOSX_PACKAGE_LOCATION "${dir}")
endforeach()

file(GLOB zn_sample_swift CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Sample/*.swift")
# Plugins' iOS code, compiled into the app for now (packaging each plugin on its own is open).
file(GLOB zn_plugin_swift CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${ZN_REPO}/plugins/*/ios/*.swift")
file(GLOB zn_swift CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/ZnRuntime/Swift/*.swift")
add_executable(ZnSample MACOSX_BUNDLE
  ZnRuntime/Host/ZNHost.mm
  ZnRuntime/Host/ZNHost.h
  ${zn_swift}
  ${zn_sample_swift}
  ${zn_plugin_swift}
  ${bundle_files}
  ${asset_files}
)
target_include_directories(ZnSample PRIVATE ZnRuntime/Host)
# CoreMotion: useTilt's gravity (Swift links it by itself too; said here so every build of the runtime says the same).
target_link_libraries(ZnSample PRIVATE zn_core "-framework QuartzCore" "-framework CoreMotion")

# Firebase (bun run tools/fetch-firebase-apple.ts; ios/third_party/firebase, not in git): Google's static XCFrameworks,
# linked when they are there. The plugins' Swift checks `canImport(FirebaseCore)` (and its own SDK's module), so the app
# builds without them. Firebase starts only when the app has its GoogleService-Info.plist (Sample/, not in git), like
# Android's google-services.json. Left out: the IDFA part of Analytics (GoogleAppMeasurementIdentitySupport, it would
# need the tracking prompt) and on-device ad conversion.
set(firebase_dir "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party/firebase")
file(GLOB firebase_marker "${firebase_dir}/.version-*")
if(firebase_marker)
  # Each part's folder holds every framework it needs, so some are in several (GoogleDataTransport, FirebaseSessions,
  # FirebaseRemoteConfigInterop, ...): each name is linked once, from the first folder that has it.
  set(firebase_parts FirebaseAnalytics FirebaseCrashlytics FirebaseMessaging FirebaseRemoteConfig FirebasePerformance)
  set(firebase_xcfs "")
  set(firebase_names "")
  foreach(part IN LISTS firebase_parts)
    file(GLOB part_xcfs "${firebase_dir}/${part}/*.xcframework")
    if(NOT part_xcfs)
      # A download from before this part was added: the plugins that need it build as "unavailable".
      message(WARNING "Firebase: no ${part} in ${firebase_dir} (an older download). Run: bun run tools/fetch-firebase-apple.ts")
      continue()
    endif()
    list(SORT part_xcfs)
    foreach(xcf IN LISTS part_xcfs)
      get_filename_component(name "${xcf}" NAME)
      if(name MATCHES "GoogleAppMeasurementIdentitySupport|GoogleAdsOnDeviceConversion" OR name IN_LIST firebase_names)
        continue()
      endif()
      list(APPEND firebase_names "${name}")
      list(APPEND firebase_xcfs "${xcf}")
    endforeach()
  endforeach()
  target_link_libraries(ZnSample PRIVATE ${firebase_xcfs} "-ObjC" "-lc++" "-lsqlite3" "-lz")
  list(LENGTH firebase_xcfs firebase_count)
  message(STATUS "Firebase: linked from ${firebase_dir} (${firebase_count} frameworks)")
else()
  message(STATUS "Firebase: not downloaded (bun run tools/fetch-firebase-apple.ts); the Firebase plugins answer \"unavailable\"")
endif()
# lottie-ios (bun run tools/fetch-lottie-apple.ts; ios/third_party/lottie, not in git), for plugins/lottie/ios.
set(lottie_xcf "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party/lottie/Lottie-Static.xcframework")
if(EXISTS "${lottie_xcf}/Info.plist")
  target_link_libraries(ZnSample PRIVATE "${lottie_xcf}")
  message(STATUS "Lottie: linked from ${lottie_xcf}")
endif()
set(firebase_plist "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Sample/GoogleService-Info.plist")
set(app_resources ${bundle_files})
if(EXISTS "${firebase_plist}")
  target_sources(ZnSample PRIVATE "${firebase_plist}")
  list(APPEND app_resources "${firebase_plist}")
endif()
set_target_properties(ZnSample PROPERTIES
  MACOSX_BUNDLE_INFO_PLIST "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Sample/Info.plist"
  RESOURCE "${app_resources}"
  XCODE_ATTRIBUTE_PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER "dev.zeronative.sample"
  XCODE_ATTRIBUTE_SWIFT_OBJC_BRIDGING_HEADER "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/ZnRuntime/Host/ZnRuntime-Bridging-Header.h"
  XCODE_ATTRIBUTE_CLANG_ENABLE_OBJC_ARC YES
  XCODE_ATTRIBUTE_SWIFT_ACTIVE_COMPILATION_CONDITIONS "$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:DEBUG>"
  XCODE_ATTRIBUTE_TARGETED_DEVICE_FAMILY "1"
  XCODE_ATTRIBUTE_LD_RUNPATH_SEARCH_PATHS "@executable_path/Frameworks"
  XCODE_EMBED_FRAMEWORKS "${hermes_xcf}"
  XCODE_EMBED_FRAMEWORKS_CODE_SIGN_ON_COPY YES
)
# Signing. Simulator (and CI) builds: ad hoc, no team. An iPhone build: -DZN_TEAM=<Apple team id>, Xcode's automatic
# signing with that team's development profile for dev.zeronative.sample (the iPhone must be in it).
set(ZN_TEAM "" CACHE STRING "Apple team id for iPhone builds; empty: ad hoc (simulator)")
if(ZN_TEAM STREQUAL "")
  set_target_properties(ZnSample PROPERTIES
    XCODE_ATTRIBUTE_CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY "-"
    XCODE_ATTRIBUTE_CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED NO
    # The simulator reads them from the build too: with aps-environment it gives the app an APNs token (simctl push's
    # background pushes still don't reach the app delegate on the iOS 26 simulator)
    XCODE_ATTRIBUTE_CODE_SIGN_ENTITLEMENTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Sample/ZnSample.entitlements")
else()
  set_target_properties(ZnSample PROPERTIES
    XCODE_ATTRIBUTE_DEVELOPMENT_TEAM "${ZN_TEAM}"
    XCODE_ATTRIBUTE_CODE_SIGN_STYLE "Automatic"
    XCODE_ATTRIBUTE_CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY "Apple Development"
    # Push (aps-environment): without it iOS gives the app no APNs token and FCM can't reach it.
    XCODE_ATTRIBUTE_CODE_SIGN_ENTITLEMENTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Sample/ZnSample.entitlements")
endif()
